title: Glow Player Heads
description: Glow Player Heads is a lightweight QoL mod for cpvp.gg that highlights player heads in your inventory with a fully customizable glow. It also includes a live head counter, customizable colors, optional animations, and toggleable keybinds.
body:
# Glow Player Heads

Never lose track of your player heads again.

**Glow Player Heads** is a lightweight utility mod built specifically for **cpvp.gg** that highlights every player head in your inventory, making them impossible to miss during fast-paced PvP.

### Features

* ✨ Glowing player heads in your inventory
* 🎨 Customizable glow color
* 🌊 Optional glow animation
* 🔘 Toggle the glow effect on or off
* ⌨️ Fully customizable keybind
* 📦 Live player head counter displayed on your screen

Whether you're looting kills or organizing your inventory, Glow Player Heads helps you find your heads instantly without wasting time.

Made for **cpvp.gg** players who want a cleaner, faster inventory experience.
